howTheSqlTestGetsItsDatabase.whatItDrops: Nothing. sql.test.ts:142 only closes its connection pools.
canItReachADatabaseItDidNotCreate: It creates no database itself: it uses the one in the URL. It cannot use a URL whose host is not
127.0.0.1, whose database name does not carry the nonce, or whose port is not the published port of
the container that carries the same nonce as its label. A database of the demo cannot satisfy that.

run-sql.mjs:15,20-23 creates a named volume and :43 only stops the container: both would stay.
run-sql.mjs:22 runs the database without a password (trust).

what: The task names the container ulpin-gk3-sqltest-<8 hex>; the test's guard accepts only
ulpin-model-control-<16 hex> with the label io.ulpin.task=DEPLOY-01. A container has one name.
decision: The container keeps the task's name. sql.test.ts (owned in this task) gets a second accepted form:
the name given in ULPIN_MODEL_SQL_CONTAINER, which must be ulpin-<word>-sqltest-<first 8 hex of the
nonce>, with a task label present. The nonce label, loopback host, port, user, database name and the
empty password in the URL are checked exactly as before. Without the variable nothing changes.
The password is not in the URL: the pg driver reads PGPASSWORD from the process environment.

howTheLedgerChildGetsItsDatabase: scripts/platform/demo-gateway-ledger.ts:8 ownerKeyLedger() (runtime.ts:43-51) reads the policy and the
key names from the process environment, and infrastructure/db.ts:26 connects to DATABASE_URL.
infrastructure/config.ts:8 probes <checkout>/.env on import; scripts/platform/isolated-env.cjs (the same
preload demo-gateway.mjs uses) hides that one path. With REPO_DATA unset no other file is read

stopRule.result: not triggered: both take their database from the environment of the process that starts them

image.declaresVolumePath: /var/lib/postgresql/data: a tmpfs is mounted there, so Docker makes no volume for it

creates: One container on the existing bridge network, one free loopback port. No volume, no network.
The password is made in the driver's memory and passed by environment name only (no value on a
command line, in a file or in any output).

commands.command: docker exec <that name> pg_isready ...; docker inspect <that name> (parsed, never printed)
docker ps -a / docker volume ls / docker network ls, names only: before, during and after

command: tsx tests/model-gateway/throwaway-steps.ts base: the schema through the server's own functions in
the manifest's order (bootstrap.postgis, core, registry, area, officer, officer-ai, spatial-ml,
usp, datasets, dataset-ml), then the gateway file of commit 63c986d5 in one query call, then two
control rows in the shape of before GK1
commands.creates: tables in the public schema of the container's own database

command: tsx tests/model-gateway/throwaway-steps.ts migrate, twice: the gateway file as it is now in one
query call, exactly as migrateModelGateway() (runtime.ts:75-79) sends it; each statement's result
commands.creates: the three columns, the table and the index of GK1; the second run must change nothing
schemas control_<nonce>_<n> in the same database

command: reconcile <reason>, behind scripts/platform/isolated-env.cjs, with a synthetic policy and
synthetic keys in the child's environment; tsx tests/model-gateway/throwaway-steps.ts mark puts
one mark in through the ledger's own retainExposure()
commands.creates: one budget row, one call row closed at zero and one mark row, all synthetic

commands.removes: the one container this task created, by its exact name, and with it its tmpfs

containers: ulpin-gk3-sqltest-<8 hex>, the exact name printed by the run
ifDockerMadeAnAnonymousVolumeAfterAll: It is checked right after the container starts. If one appeared, the container is removed with
docker rm --force --volumes <its exact name>, which removes only that container's own anonymous
volume, and the run is reported as a finding. No docker volume rm is ever run.

neverRun: docker compose in any form; down, prune, stop, restart or rm of any name on the lists above;
docker volume rm; any connection to a database this task did not create; any provider call;
any read of a .env file, the demo settings or anything under E:/BhuAayam-data/runtime.
ifSomethingFails: A failed migration call is recorded and not run again. The container is still removed by its exact
name, and the report says what failed.
